LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.Smartstore.Google.Auth
LocaleResource.Value: Lets customers register and sign in with their Google account.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value:
Google sign-in needs an OAuth 2.0 client in the Google Cloud Console:

  1. Select or create a project in the Google Cloud Console.
  2. Google Auth Platform > Branding (OAuth consent screen): enter the app name, support email, store domain and the links to the privacy policy and terms of service. Under Audience choose External and publish the app (In production) after testing.
  3. Under Data Access use only the scopes openid, userinfo.email and userinfo.profile.
  4. Clients > Create client: application type Web application. Enter the redirect URI below exactly as shown at Authorized redirect URIs (https, no trailing slash). Use a separate client and http://localhost:<port>/signin-google for development.
  5. Enter the generated Client ID and Client secret in this form and save. Never share the secret by email, chat or in a code repository.
  6. Activate "Google Login" under Configuration > External authentication.

LocaleResource.Name: NotConfiguredAdminNotice
LocaleResource.Value: Admin notice: Google Login is active, but the OAuth Client ID or Client secret is missing. Customers do not see the button.

LocaleResource.Name: NotConfigured
LocaleResource.Value: The Google button is not shown in the store until the Client ID and Client secret are entered.

LocaleResource.Name: RedirectUriMismatch
LocaleResource.Value: You opened this page at an address other than the store URL. If customers use that address as well, add this redirect URI at Google too: {0}

LocaleResource.Name: ConsumerKey.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Client ID of the OAuth 2.0 web client in the Google Cloud Console (….apps.googleusercontent.com).

LocaleResource.Name: ConsumerSecret.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Client secret of the OAuth 2.0 web client. Enter it in this form only, never in a code repository or email.

LocaleResource.Name: RedirectUri.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: The address to be entered exactly at "Authorized redirect URIs" in the Google Cloud Console.
